Nour Time helps your child enjoy screen time in a healthy amount. You choose the apps and the time. When the time runs out, Nour kindly lets your child know it\'s time for something else.
One shared time budget for the apps you choose
Locks automatically when the time is up
What Nour Time needs, and why

Nour Time is a parental control app. To limit your child\'s time on the apps you choose, it needs the permissions below. Everything stays on this device. Nour Time doesn\'t collect, upload or share any personal data.
You\'ll grant each permission yourself, one at a time, and you can turn any of them off later from the phone\'s settings.
4 digits. You\'ll use it to unlock the device and open Nour Time\'s settings. Keep it away from your child.
The PINs didn\'t match. Let\'s try again.
This PIN is easy to guess. Please choose another one.
Wrong PIN. Attempts left before a wait: %1$d
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$s
If your child ever learns the PIN, this question keeps the selected apps and the settings closed during a lock period. Write a question only you can answer.
e.g. What was my grandmother\'s village called?
Spaces, capital letters and hamza/alef forms (أ إ آ ا) don\'t matter.
Write a question of at least 5 characters.
The answer needs at least 2 letters.
Detects which app is open, so the timer only runs while a selected app is in use.

Nour Time uses the Accessibility service only to know which app is open on the screen. That way the timer runs only while one of the selected apps is in use, and the \"Time\'s up\" screen appears at the right moment. It doesn\'t read, record or share what your child types or sees, and nothing leaves this device.
In Settings, open \"Installed apps\" (or \"Downloaded apps\"), tap Nour Time, and turn it on.
Is the switch greyed out? On Android 13 and newer: open App info, tap the ⋮ menu, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
A backup way to detect the open app, and the source of your daily usage stats.
Nour Time uses usage access as a backup way to know which app is in the foreground, and to show you how long each app was used today. This information stays on this device.
Find Nour Time in the list and turn on \"Permit usage access\".
Shows the friendly \"Time\'s up\" screen on top of the selected apps.
When the time runs out, Nour Time shows a friendly \"Time\'s up\" screen on top of the selected apps. Android needs this permission to allow that.
Turn on \"Allow display over other apps\" for Nour Time.
Locks the screen when time is up and protects Nour Time from being removed.
Device admin lets Nour Time lock the screen when the time is up, and stops the app from being uninstalled without your PIN. Nour Time can\'t read or erase your data with it.
Locks the screen when your child\'s time is up, and protects Nour Time from being removed without the parent PIN.
Android shows a small notification while Nour Time runs in the background.
Android requires a small, silent notification while Nour Time protects the device in the background. Nour Time never sends ads or promotional notifications.
Keeps the timer running reliably in the background.
Some phones put background apps to sleep to save battery. Allowing Nour Time to run without restrictions keeps the timer accurate. Nour Time uses very little battery.
%1$s phones can stop apps from starting on their own. Allow Nour Time to autostart so protection comes back after the phone restarts.
In the screen that opens, turn on Nour Time. If it doesn\'t open, look for \"Autostart\" or \"App launch\" in the phone\'s settings.
Setup is complete. The live timer and the \"Time\'s up\" screen arrive in the next updates.
Some permissions are off. Nour Time can\'t fully protect the device until they\'re on.
So Nour speaks to your child the right way and shows a fitting \"Time\'s up\" screen.

All the apps you turn on share one time budget.

Soon you\'ll split the day into study, play, meal and sleep periods, each with its own \"Time\'s up\" screen.

Nour Time detects which app is open on the screen so it can limit your child\'s time on the apps you choose. It doesn\'t read or collect anything your child types or sees, and no data leaves this device.
